entries.text: The `bigquery`, `cloud`, `cloud-spark`, `cloud-spark-gcp`, `cloud-spark-databricks`, `lakesail`, `velox` and `all` extras now require `grpcio` 1.84.1 or newer. Older `grpcio` releases verify TLS against their own bundled root list, which still trusts the roots the compromised eMudhra emSign intermediates chain to, so BigQuery Storage, Dataproc, Databricks Connect and Spark Connect connections stayed exposed even after the `certifi` upgrade.
